network_stalls.what_they_mean: Requests from this PC to the page over the tailnet that got no answer within 5 s, each retried. They show the page could not be reached from the PC at those moments. They do not show whether the app or the tailnet was at fault. When the page was asked on the board itself (samplers in tandem, worst, sustained, hang_local) the slowest answer was under 90 ms and none failed, but no sampler ran at the exact moments of most stalls, so that points to the tailnet without proving it.

failed.rejected: The model looked at one small tile of tissue and read it as background, labelled BACK, with a combined confidence of 90%. The model has two heads that each give their own answer. Both heads picked BACK, Head A with 96% confidence and Head B with 50%. The two heads agree. The tile is flagged for review because the confidence of the two heads differs and the review score of 0.60 shows the review head is unsure. In a tissue image, background means an empty part of the slide with little or no tissue.
